description.short: Continuous audit & compliance readiness inside Microsoft 365 Copilot.
description.full: AuditAlly is a Microsoft 365 Copilot declarative agent that grounds answers in your policy library (Foundry IQ), maps evidence to SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / GDPR controls, computes live audit readiness, finds gaps, and creates remediation tasks through an OAuth-secured MCP server. All sample data is synthetic.
